original_value: This paper presents a fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) method, which uses one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN) and WaveCluster clustering analysis to detect and diagnose sensor faults in the supply air temperature (Tsup) control loop of the air handling unit. In this approach, 1-D CNN is employed to extract man-guided features from raw data, and the extracted features are analyzed by WaveCluster clustering. The suspicious sensor faults are indicated and categorized by denoting clusters. Moreover, the Tc acquittal procedure is introduced to further improve the accuracy of FDD. In validation, false alarm ratio and missing diagnosis ratio are mainly used to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed FDD method. Results show that the abrupt sensor faults in Tsup control loop can be efficiently detected and diagnosed, and the proposed method is equipped with good robustness within the noise range of 6 dBm∼13 dBm.

result.paraphrase: This paper proposes a fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) approach that combines a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN) with WaveCluster clustering analysis to identify and diagnose sensor faults in the supply air temperature (Tsup) control loop of an air handling unit. In the method, the 1-D CNN extracts man-guided features from raw data, and WaveCluster clustering is then applied to those extracted features. Suspicious sensor faults are indicated and categorized by marking clusters. In addition, the Tc acquittal procedure is introduced to further improve FDD accuracy. During validation, the false alarm ratio and missing diagnosis ratio are mainly used to show the effectiveness of the proposed FDD method. The results indicate that abrupt sensor faults in the Tsup control loop can be detected and diagnosed efficiently, and that the method has good robustness within the 6 dBm∼13 dBm noise range.
